population: Canonical SEC ownership Table I P/S reported acquisitions/dispositions, with source-backed issuer/security/listing identity where available. P/S does not prove an open-market venue. Include unresolved, missing, terminal and non-actionable records in coverage accounting. No current ticker-universe filter.

feature_definitions.event_type: Canonical purchase/sale classification available under the declared source-public/actionable policy; not an assertion of open-market venue.
feature_definitions.reported_shares: Canonical transaction_shares quantity in shares, where supplied; no USD trade-size buckets because SEC reported-price currency is unknown.
feature_definitions.known_relationship_context: Positive count of source-backed matching relationship assertions with eligible known/valid intervals at the decision time. Unknown, late-known or absent/incomplete context is unavailable, never false or zero. No current LittleSis graph backfill.

expected_direction: Predeclared proposal: purchase-event 60-session SPY-relative mean exceeds sale-event mean. This is a descriptive contrast, not a short-sale strategy. 20/90-session comparisons are secondary and cannot replace a failed primary endpoint.
exclusions: All candidate events are accounted at each horizon. Exclude unsupported source/type and public-date windows explicitly; reject unknown/mismatched timing or identity. Do not drop unresolved, delisted, missing-price, censored or absent-current-universe records. Calendar year 2020 is an embargo between discovery and validation; no discovery event is selected in that year. Future window amendments require fresh review and cannot restore untouched status after inspection.
decision_standard: PROPOSED, NOT ACCEPTED: insufficient if either arm has fewer than 1000 complete validation events or fewer than 200 distinct issuers, or if fewer than 90% of selected actionable events have complete 60-session benchmark outcomes. A positive research finding would additionally require the 95% issuer-cluster percentile-bootstrap confidence interval lower bound (5000 cluster resamples with replacement, seed 1729, retain all events within each sampled issuer, event-weighted arm means, nearest-rank 2.5/97.5 percentiles; insufficient if more than 1% of resamples lack either arm) of the purchase-minus-sale SPY-excess mean contrast to exceed zero under prespecified 10/25/50-bps round-trip stock-cost sensitivity, plus positive purchase-arm net excess at 25 bps. Descriptive tables alone cannot pass this standard. Failure remains negative/inconclusive; no replacement horizon, cutoff search, model or optimized score. Inference/cost sensitivity is not implemented by this build slice and must be reviewed before use.
dependence_and_inspection_policy: No IID inference across correlated event rows; report issuer event concentration. Before any real validation output, supervisor review must accept and register this exact protocol/code/origin inventory. Log all hypotheses, denied attempts and inspections in an append-only local journal. Prior overlapping real inspections, including under renamed hypotheses, prevent a new untouched claim; a crashed attempt is potentially inspected. This file is an unreviewed proposal, not a preregistration or claim that historical evidence is untouched.
execution_and_costs: Existing XNYS actionable regular-session open to Nth-following-session close; explicit same feed/adjustment/provider for stock and SPY. IEX is not consolidated execution. Engine results are gross hypothetical daily-bar outcomes; fills, liquidity, costs, slippage and clustered inference remain unevaluated. No positions, orders or live paper execution.

availability_policies.rationale: Explicit SEC acceptance plus five-minute research assumption; not measured first dissemination or guaranteed vendor/collector latency.
